A concept in concepts that is absent from facts has no 10-K fact for a period in this window; the filer may have reported it for earlier periods, which this file does not hold. A concept FinSight reads that is not in concepts (see not_carried) was never fetched, so whether the filer reports it is unknown until the file is refreshed.
